target_profile.store_type: Independent retail laundry & dry cleaning storefront with on-premise washing machines or local processing shed
target_profile.staff_profile: 1-2 counter attendants, 2-3 dhobi/press operators, 1-2 bike delivery riders
target_profile.current_tools: Manual paper ledger, WhatsApp personal chat, or basic pirated billing software

aspirations: Establish a branded, modern online presence to compete with chains like Tumbledry and UClean
Expand delivery reach across a 3-5 km neighborhood radius without hiring expensive digital agencies
Retain repeat customers and sell high-margin prepaid monthly packages (e.g. ₹2,000 laundry wallet)
Prevent staff theft, garment damage disputes, and missing clothes
growth_blockers: Western SaaS tools ($89-$150/mo = ₹7,500-₹12,500/mo) are too expensive and lack Indian payment/language support
Indian legacy systems (QDC) require Windows desktop PCs and have outdated user interfaces
Lack of marketing expertise to run Meta/Google ads or build customer mobile apps

our_crm_killer_value_proposition.core_pillar_1_instant_digital_storefront: Auto-generated branded web ordering page + WhatsApp catalog in 5 minutes with UPI payment links.
our_crm_killer_value_proposition.core_pillar_2_anti_loss_ai_protection: Snap photo of garment -> AI logs fabric, brand, and pre-existing stains -> Wash-proof thermal QR tag printed in 2 seconds.
our_crm_killer_value_proposition.core_pillar_3_whatsapp_conversational_os: 100% of customer interactions (pickup booking, ready notifications, invoice payment, delivery feedback) occur inside WhatsApp without forcing the customer to download an app.
our_crm_killer_value_proposition.core_pillar_4_iot_anti_theft_machine_loc: Smart plug bridge ensures machines run only for billable orders, saving ₹15,000-₹30,000/month in prevented cash leakage.
our_crm_killer_value_proposition.core_pillar_5_unbeatable_pricing: ₹999/month ($12/mo) flat per store with zero transaction cuts or hidden hardware mandates.
